function copyOpen<T extends number[]>(source: T): [number, number?] {
  return [...source];
}
function optional<T extends [number?]>(source: T): [number] {
  return [...source];
}
function wrong<T extends [string, ...number[]]>(source: T): [string, ...string[]] {
  return [...source];
}
function mismatch<T extends [number] | [string]>(source: T): [number] {
  return [...source];
}
function target<T extends [number]>(source: [number]): [...T] {
  return [...source];
}
function nestedOpen<U extends string[], T extends [...U, boolean]>(source: T): [string, boolean] {
  return [...source];
}
function nestedChoice<U extends [number] | [string], T extends [...U, boolean]>(source: T): [number, boolean] {
  return [...source];
}
function conflicting<T extends [number] & [string]>(source: T): [boolean] {
  return [...source];
}
function readonlyTagged<T extends readonly [number] & { tag: string }>(source: T): [number] {
  return [...source];
}
function mixed<T extends [number] & readonly [1]>(source: T): [1] {
  return [...source];
}
function opaque<U extends [number] & { tag: string }, T extends [...U, string]>(source: T): [number, string] {
  return [...source];
}
function addedSuffix<U extends [number] & { tag: string }>(source: U): [number, string] {
  return [...source, 'tail'];
}
function readonlySpread<U extends [number] & { tag: string }>(source: readonly [...U]): readonly [number] {
  return source;
}
function sameOpen<T extends unknown[]>(source: T): T {
  return [...source];
}
const noFirstPosition: { 1: 'second' } = [1, 'second'];
const missingOptionalPosition: { 0?: 'first' } = [];
const wrongPosition: { 0: 'first' } = ['other'];
